title: The Second Coming
lead: The promise that Jesus will return in glory to judge and to set the world right. Jesus speaks of it (Matthew 24–25), the angels promise it at his ascension (Acts 1:11), the letters wait for it (1 Thessalonians 4:13–18; Jude 14–15), and Revelation opens and closes with it (Revelation 1:7; 22:20).
